message.reasoning:
With only $28 cash sitting on Short Line, I'm eyeing the upcoming spots - Park Place and Boardwalk are both loaded with houses and could wipe me out if I land there, so this next roll feels risky given my current holdings.

I've got all three greens as a monopoly but can't build with $200 houses needed and only $28 on hand. No good trades come to mind since the other players aren't offering much I need, so I'll just end my turn and keep mortgaging in reserve for whenever rent actually comes due.
